name: folio
description: Folio - evidence-first professional bookkeeping and tax workspace alpha

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @folio/web" "npm run dev -w @folio/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @folio/web && npm run build -w @folio/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @folio/web && npm run typecheck -w @folio/api
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build -w @folio/web && npm run deploy -w @folio/api
